blocks.x: Autonomous Supply Chain Control Tower exists because a specific failure keeps repeating: planning runs on batch snapshots; exceptions consume planners; network re-optimization takes weeks; visibility is stitched from portals.
Planning runs on batch snapshots; exceptions consume planners; network re-optimization takes weeks; visibility is stitched from portals.

The failure Autonomous Supply Chain Control Tower answers is structural, not personal: processes that grew by accretion now decide things faster than they can be checked. Engineering the path is cheaper than hiring around it.

We deliver the control tower: event-driven visibility, demand/inventory/transport decision hubs, agentic exception remediation within policy, scenario engines for disruption, and outcome SLOs that operations leadership steers by.

blocks.x: Autonomous Supply Chain Control Tower composes KYC Management System, EEMS Platform — platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Industrial, Retail & Consumer Goods, Energy & Utilities.

Autonomous Supply Chain Control Tower runs on phases: phase one prices the problem in your own units and signs the baseline; phase two designs with the risk envelope written down; phase three proves a bounded slice on your data; phase four scales what survived the gate. What we promise is modest and checkable: a signed baseline, a bounded slice in production, and evidence your auditors can read without a guide. For Autonomous Supply Chain Control Tower, that discipline is not optional — it is the engagement model.
